content: Section 12.16 of the American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines has been updated to include additional considerations for managing vision loss, the use of FDA-approved devices for neuropathy treatment, and the critical role of rehabilitation and comprehensive evaluation in patient care. Section 22 has been revised to emphasize the importance of proper screening for peripheral artery disease and to advocate for the inclusion of appropriate podiatric specialists in the development and implementation of treatment plans.
